content.Section 7.1.2: Discusses dietary sodium restriction in heart failure patients. Studies suggest a connection between sodium intake and heart failure management, with varying opinions on the benefits of strict sodium restriction.
content.Section 7.1.3: Focuses on management strategies for heart failure, particularly exercise prescription, and cardiac rehabilitation. Studies highlight the efficacy and safety of exercise training, cardiac rehabilitation, and the positive outcomes on exercise capacity and quality of life in heart failure patients.
